scripts.build: npm run build -w @spherse/i18n && npm run build -w @spherse/presets && npm run build -w @spherse/core && npm run build -w @spherse/server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:landing: npm run build --workspace=@spherse/i18n && npm run build --workspace=packages/landing
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test --workspace=packages/core && npm test --workspace=packages/server && npm test --workspace=packages/i18n && npm test --workspace=packages/app && npm test --workspace=packages/desktop && npm run check:i18n
scripts.verify:e2e: npm run verify && npm run test:e2e --workspace=packages/desktop
